sources.entry: Bloom - BLOOM by Hugging Face is a model similar to GPT-3 #free

summary.name: BLOOM
summary.one_liner: BLOOM is a GPT-3-style autoregressive language model from the BigScience Workshop, documented in the Hugging Face Transformers library.
use_cases: generate text with an open multilingual language model
text classification with a decoder-only model
token classification or question answering fine-tuning
configure and instantiate a small BLOOM model from scratch
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Transformers API reference for BLOOM. It describes BloomConfig, BloomModel, BloomForCausalLM (language modeling head with tied embeddings) and BloomForSequenceClassification (last-token classification head), with parameter lists and forward-pass return values. The architecture is described as similar to GPT-3 (auto-regressive next-token prediction), trained on 46 natural languages and 13 programming languages. Several smaller versions were trained on the same data. The page also links to blog posts on inference optimization (including DeepSpeed and Accelerate) and training, plus task guides for causal LM, text classification, token classification and question answering.
notable: Trained on 46 natural languages and 13 programming languages via the BigScience Workshop
Architecture similar to GPT-3, with multiple model sizes
Includes causal LM, sequence classification and other task heads in Transformers
caveats: The page does not state a license or pricing; the 'open source' label is from the listing context rather than the page text.
Experimental tensor-parallel options (pretraining_tp, slow_but_exact) are noted as experimental.
